pkgmetadata.longdescription: bentoo-tray is a session daemon that reads the bentoo overlay's notices feed and the unread bentoo news items, keeps those that concern packages installed from the bentoo repository, and shows them as desktop notifications and a StatusNotifierItem tray icon. It ships from the bentoolkit repository as a separate binary.

use.flag: Install the systemd user unit that starts the tray with the graphical session
